name: Partners for Fish and Wildlife Program (competitive NOFO)
summary: Federal cooperative agreements for habitat restoration and protection on private and tribal lands in the United States, open to nonprofits, businesses, tribes and others who consult the local Partners office before applying. Listed as a project-lead cooperative agreement, not a payment to landowners for land use.

calls.label: FY26 notice of funding opportunity F26AS00068
calls.note: The page also says the program seeks projects year-round and applicants must consult their local Partners office first.
